apparatus.note: The original ASV 1901 marginal note states: “The word God, in place of He who, rests on no sufficient ancient evidence. Some ancient authorities read which.”
The original printed margin gives the Greek as “the deposit” for the entrusted teaching. The scanned page retains its exact typography.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
